name: View Request / Incident
description: Returns the specified incident or request

record.description: Full response object: `RFC_NUMBER`, `STATUS` (`STATUS_EN`, `STATUS_GUID`), `RECIPIENT`, `REQUESTOR`, `LOCATION`, `DEPARTMENT`, dates, `E_*` fields. `COMMENT` and `DESCRIPTION` are **links** (`{HREF}`), not text: use *View Request / Incident Comment* for the comment
